nom: SOME BY MI AHA BHA PHA 14 Days Super Miracle Spot All Kill Cream

avis.titre: It truly works miracles on the skin
avis.texte: ⭐ ⭐ ⭐ ⭐ ⭐ 5/5 – It truly works miracles on the skin I’ve been using the SOME BY MI AHA BHA PHA 30 Days Miracle Cream for several weeks now, and the results have been amazing. From the very first days, I noticed my skin feeling smoother, calmer, and with less texture. The combination of AHA, BHA, and PHA exfoliates very gently without causing irritation, and the Centella Asiatica really helps reduce redness and leaves the skin feeling fresh and soothed. I love that it’s lightweight, absorbs quickly, and doesn’t leave a sticky feeling. It also helps control breakouts and keeps the skin clearer and more balanced. It’s perfect for daily use, even if you have sensitive skin. This is definitely a cream that delivers what it promises. If you’re looking for something that improves your skin quickly and without harshness, this is the best choice. I will definitely repurchase it.

avis.titre: Lightweight but effective.. great for smoothing texture over timeLightweight but effective.. great for smoothing texture
avis.texte: I bought this for my son originally because I wanted something to help him with skin texture and occasional breakouts without being too harsh.. I ended up using it more often than him. It has been a really nice balance.. calming and cooling but also exfoliating. Right away, the cream feels lightweight, a gel texture, and absorbs quickly. It doesn’t sit heavy on the skin or leave a greasy feeling, which makes it easy to use both day and night. After using it consistently, I noticed my skin feels smoother and looks a bit more even overall. It’s not an overnight transformation, but with regular use it definitely helps improve texture for me.. and keeps breakouts more under control for my teen son. Pros: •Lightweight and absorbs quickly •Helps smooth skin texture •Gentle enough for regular use •Doesn’t feel greasy or heavy •Great price, especially when on sale Cons: •Results take consistency (not instant) •May not be strong enough for severe acne Overall, I’d recommend this if you’re looking for a gentle, everyday product to help maintain clearer, smoother skin over time. For reference neither of us have sensitive skin and we’re both pretty balanced.

avis.titre: Smaller pores! But to maximize benefit, pair with light serum!
avis.texte: Honestly its pretty good! Can't say its worth 5 stars though. I love that this is a tea tree formula! It really helps treat my breakouts! Some moisturizers aggravate my breakouts, but this one helps diminish them! My boyfriend likes it too! Great for combo skin though sometimes I feel my skin produces more oil when using but hey, my pores are a lot smaller! Somehow it seems as if my sebum is breaking down? I often feel like its hydration isn't enough even though I have combo skin. I do recommend pairing with the light serum! It's an amazing duo! Works better than just the moisturizer alone

Absolutely love this cream. When I was actively breaking out, this was the only moisturizer I used on my face. It never irritated my skin and still provided enough active ingredients in the moisture to keep my skin balanced. It feels super lightweight yet very hydrating, and it didn’t clog my pores at all. Over time, I definitely noticed my skin clearing up and looking healthier. If you’re dealing with breakouts and want something gentle, moisturizing, and effective, this cream is a great choice.
I love this cream. I keep re-ordering it. It’s just a mellow face cream that simply soothes and controls oil. Perfect for longtime acne sufferers who want to be kind to their skin ;)

avis.titre: In just a few days there's a good difference in skin texture.
avis.texte: It's not even 30 days yet and there's already a good difference in my skin texture plus it seems to make my skin glow. I will say to give it time for your skin to absorb before putting on makeup because it leaves your skin feeling tacky as it dries. Oh and it also has a peppermint like kind of smell that I actually don't mind but I think some people might so there's that. But so far so good so I recommend.

avis.titre: My favorite go to Face Cream
avis.texte: Ive been using this for about 2 years now and it's been wonderful for my skin. Because of the BHA, it removes blackheads and can be used on dark underarms if you use the toner liquid version. The whole line is amazing.

Esta crema me encanta. Es súper fresca, tiene un aroma muy agradable que recuerda al pepino y aporta una sensación revitalizante al instante. Además, deja la piel luminosa y con un brillo natural precioso, como si estuviera más hidratada y saludable. Se absorbe muy bien y es perfecta tanto para la rutina de mañana como para dar un extra de frescor en cualquier momento del día.

Crème qui convient parfaitement à ma peau, elle a contribuée à réduire mon acné très rapidement. Ma texture de peau s'est améliorée et elle est devenue lisse. La texture et la senteur de la crème est très agréable. J'ai une peau à tendance grasse et acnéique donc cette crème est parfaite pour ma peau.

This has done miracles to my hormonal back and chest acne. I’ve had it for decades and within a week there was a significant improvement, less spots, and the deeper ones were resolving a lot quicker. It changed my skin texture so it felt like my pores could actually breathe and sort things out themselves. Everything is now less inflamed, I have minimal acne and now just focusing on pigmentation and maintenance. Genuinely very very impressed. I’d tried EVERYTHING at this point except acutane and only tried this product so I could write a snarky review saying how it didn’t work and I have well and truly been humbled. Definitely give it a go.
Commande avec Amazon, on 2 le suivi reçu en temps en heure bien emballé, le produit est bien comme notifié dans l annoncé

This product line has been a miracle for my scarred and acne prone skin. I also use the body wash because I have HS and it’s kept flare ups away! The serum is luxury and so is the eye cream. Get the face cream too! It’s lightweight and yet you can FEEL the barrier it gives like it just injected your skin with hydration. Forget expensive treatments and turn to this brand! I’ll use it for life! Smells fresh and light non irritating too. Bottom line: this face cream is like hyolouronic acid injections without the trauma and price tag buy it!

This face moisturizer has been amazing. I use this every morning after my shower and my skin has already improved. It’s smoother, moisturized and visibly less wrinkles. Even with my skin sensitivity this has had no issues for me. There is a eucalyptus type smell but light. It’s nice and refreshing. Will put on subscription. Product lasts a long time.

avis.titre: Great moisturizer and feels amazing on the skin
avis.texte: Ever since I got into skincare I wondered why all the moisturizers felt so heavy and greasy on my face! After finding out I had combo skin, I started to look for gel moisturizers, and I think I found the one. This moisturizer when paired with the toner (also from this brand) is a game changer! They have my skin so hydrated even in the wintertime without feeling greasy on my face! And after using BPO on my face, every other moisturizer makes my face sting, but this one does not, it makes it so much more but darted without any of the burning sensation, all thanks to the centella that’s inside this. Overall, it’s a great product for the price and I have bought this product many many times already. I am on my fourth one!

avis.titre: A True Miracle for My Skin!
avis.texte: I am absolutely in love with the SOME BY MI AHA BHA PHA 30 Days Miracle Cream! This is my second jar, and it has truly been a game-changer for my skincare routine. Made from tea tree water, it's perfect for my sensitive skin. This cream is incredibly mild yet effective, providing the right amount of moisture without feeling heavy or greasy. My skin feels calmer and more soothed after each use, and I've noticed a significant improvement in the appearance of my pores and sebum control. The combination of AHA, BHA, and PHA has helped to gently exfoliate my skin, leaving it smoother and clearer. I highly recommend to anyone struggling with sensitive skin or looking for a reliable, effective moisturizer.

I love this stuff. I keep re-ordering. Smells wonderful. Soothes my face after all the makeup remover, then cleanser, then toner, then anti aging serums. This is the only one I enjoy putting on. The consistency is perfect. Not sure if it helps with my wrinkles, but it feels so good I don’t even care.

avis.titre: Didn’t work for my mature combination skin
avis.texte: I had high hopes for this cream based on the other reviews. But this did not work for me. I have mature combination skin. This cream clogged my pores and did not absorb into my skin. I used it for 2 months but had to discontinue after this irritating my skin.

Definitely not for sensitive skin it also did burn a bit as well. Doesnt seem like purging to me seems like a reaction to this product. I did not have this before even trying new products never did me this bad. Don’t recommend please save yourself the time if your skin is sensitive.

Finished one pot! A little goes a long way. One 2oz. jar lasted me 7 months, using it consistently twice a day. It's super hydrating and doesn't feel like it's just sitting on top of my skin. My skin feels hydrated throughout the day especially during the cold dry winter season!

This product arrived damaged and opened. Product packaging/box was ripped and the product labeling had tears in it. It definitely looked used/opened and not in great condition. Was not comfortable using this at all and have requested a refund.

avis.titre: Looks used. Lid wasnt closed tight.
avis.texte: Just received. Opened it and it looks used. The jar is not full and the lid was loose. I am uneasy to use it now.
When I opened the bottle, I knew it was opened before. It wasn’t tight. After that, the cream dropped on my hand. Like someone used it before. Ver disappointed experience.

Was recommended in place of Dr.Dennis Alpha Beta Peel Pads as a cheaper alternative. I had an instant reaction with a cystic blackout. Do not recommend if you are acne prone. It’s not a good dupe given it’s scented.

avis.titre: Better than any $100 moisturizer I’ve used
avis.texte: This is a game changer for all skin types. Leaves skin moisturized, smooth, blemish free. I added it to my skin regimen a little over a year ago. It goes on last after my serums and creams, I’ve never been happier with my skin at 44yo.

I love this cream so much! I’ve cleared out 3 tubs of it and am buying it for the 4th time. Combined with a snail ampoule my skin looks so great and hydrated. My mom even commented that my skin looks great and she usually doesnt make a comment like that often. I have combination skin for reference :)! I feel like it helps out with my breakouts a ton.
My go to a skin care brand I love their product. They completely change my face.

If you have acne-prone and oily skin, this is your moisturizer. It smells like mint but doesn’t bother me. It feels refreshing, it’s not heavy and it’s very hydrating. Definitely my favorite moisturizer. It does work and good price.
I’ve been using this product for 3 yrs now and is the absolute best for oily skin. Use the toner and serum before for the ultimate glass skin
This stuff is like magic! yes, it is gentle. No, It's not greasy. You will have some mild peeling a few days after use, but it's nothing some lotion cant handle!
Lil bit of scent to it and I feel it feels lil heavy but it’s great 😊
